items.title: Faster, cleaner re-attach
items.text: Reopening Ghoztty brings persistent sessions back quicker and renders them correctly right away, via a structured snapshot + delta replay instead of raw scrollback dumps — no smeared or mis-sized panes, and a resize can no longer be dropped mid-re-attach.

items.title: No more spurious agent-update prompts
items.text: Upgrading the app no longer asks you to reset sessions for an agent that didn't actually change. The agent is flagged "new" only when its own code really changed.
